explanation: Keep one current element per sorted array in an ordered multimap. Record the span between its minimum and maximum, then advance the array supplying the minimum. Stop when that array is exhausted.
timeComplexity: O(N log(k+1)) time over N total elements of k arrays; k=3 in this question.
